description:
Noticed while fixing bd-95p. PRE-EXISTING CLI-wide shape, not made worse there.

`bn sync` now prints a proper diagnostic on failure/timeout — remote, dirty,
sync_in_progress, consecutive_failures, last error. Human-readable, exit 1.

But under `--json`, stdout stays clean (correct — verified) and only a one-line
error goes to stderr. So a scripting consumer gets the exit code and nothing
machine-readable about WHY. They would have to scrape the human text, which is
exactly what --json exists to avoid.

The lane state is already assembled for the human renderer, so this is
plumbing: emit the same fields as a JSON object on the error path.

Applies beyond sync — worth checking whether other commands' error paths have
the same gap before picking a shape, so we do it once, consistently. Wider than
one command, hence P3 rather than folding it into bd-95p.
title: kopi-beans: --json mode emits no structured diagnostic for a failed/timed-out sync
